title: DSH BOOST evidence card (dsh-boost-card/1)
description: One evidence card per practice, per plugin. These are exactly the thirteen fields `40-checker/scripts/level-audit.mjs` requires (BOOST_CARD_FIELDS); a missing or malformed field downgrades the practice to not-measured. `expiresAt` must not precede `generatedAt`, and a past `expiresAt` makes the card stale; both rules need the run date, so they live in level-audit rather than in this schema. `recordHash` is sha256 over the card JSON without that field; the validator checks the shape, a reviewer recomputes it. The card may sit under `evidenceCard` or as an object under `evidence` in the LEV evidence file.

subject.description: What was measured, as name@version. Not the repository name.

host.description: DSH / Cordis / Node versions and the platform, for example "dsh 0.2.2-alpha.3 / cordis 4.0.6-alpha.2 / node 24.9 / linux-x64".

method.description: How it was measured, including the run count or comparator and any caveat such as single-run.

scope.description: Which LEV practice and which part of the plugin, for example "LEV-6 stable prefix / assembly".

command.description: The exact command that produced the result.

negativeControl.description: The same measurement with the practice disabled or the plugin off; without it a number is not evidence.

generatedAt.description: The day the measurement was run (YYYY-MM-DD).

expiresAt.description: When the measurement stops being current (YYYY-MM-DD), not before generatedAt. 180 days is a reasonable cap.

recordHash.description: sha256 over the canonical card JSON without this field.

claimLevel.description: Be honest; anything stronger than self-reported is not self-declared.

issuer.description: Who ran it: author, an org, or a CI job.

selfAssessed.description: True only when the author ran and judged the measurement.

examples.subject: @acme/dsh-hello@0.1.0
examples.method: single run: startup, reload, and tokens per turn; nonce arm as negative control
examples.scope: LEV-6 stable prefix / assembly - hello example tool and prompt declarations
examples.negativeControl: same bench with the nonce arm: prefix reuse 0%, first divergence at system byte 0
